assets.prompt: Create one wide 16:9 illustrated story opening for the Silent Hill (1999 original PlayStation) Groaner. This is an original compatible composition for a fan fighting game, grounded strictly in the provided source references. Reference 1 is the original Groaner anatomical model: preserve its lean low four-legged canine body, complete long thin tail, long blunt muzzle, pale clouded eyes, pointed small ears, tan-brown mottled hide, four canine paws and black claws. Reference 2 is a native original-game screenshot of the Levin Street house and doghouse; use its exact mundane location identity and cold fog/snow. Reference 3 is the project's already-integrated stage composition of that same house: preserve the composition, blue-grey timber house, steps on left, doghouse near middle, leaning small mailbox to the right, low curb and road. Add exactly one Groaner fully visible in the lower-left-to-middle road foreground, oriented toward the right, a low alert walking stance with all four limbs readable, entire muzzle, ears, feet and tail inside the canvas. Keep the Groaner at plausible dog scale relative to the steps and mailbox. Its identity must match the first reference and must not become a wolf, furry dog, skeletal creature, Sniffer Dog, or two-headed animal. Quiet cold opaque fog, sparse falling pale snow, subdued blue-grey and brown game-like painterly raster texture. No person, no other monster, no blood pool, no new architecture, no supernatural effects. Do not reproduce the person from reference 2. No title, text, logo, UI, frame or watermark. One complete opaque landscape image, ideally 1672 by 941 pixels. Keep road and building legible; this is a restrained source-grounded cutscene still rather than an action poster.

Reference 1 is the original monster model, shown bent forward: preserve its sealed bound upper-body skin envelope with arms confined within it, featureless head area continuous with the torso, narrow pale mottled lower legs and dark foot surfaces; it has two legs and no freely exposed arms, hands, eyes, face, costume or extra limbs. Reference 2 is a native original-game street screenshot: use ONLY the upright distant creature for the standing anatomy and posture, not the humans, corpse, blood or car. Reference 3 is the original Neely's Bar frontage photograph from gameplay, use the brown brick, timber door and newspaper-covered windows beneath a worn dark teal awning. Reference 4 is the project's integrated Neely/Sanders frontage backdrop: retain that complete existing scene composition, adjoining shop on left, central timber door, big paper-covered window and awning on right, street pole at far right, cracked sidewalk and dark street in foreground. Add exactly one fully visible standing Lying Figure in the lower-left street foreground, slightly leaning in its characteristic constrained posture and turned in a slight three-quarter profile toward the right. Keep all of the sealed torso and both legs and feet inside frame, plausible human scale. Original 2001 design, not remake, not the early concept with red boots or visible mouth; no free arm or detached limb. Restrained grey fog, weathered brown and green-grey palette, quiet source-game dread, detailed painterly raster consistent with the existing scene reference. No attack spray, new powers, extra creatures, humans, bodies or blood. Do not invent location-specific history or signs. No title, text, logo, UI, frame or watermark. One opaque wide landscape still, ideally 1672 by 941 pixels.
